title: Sexual Performance Anxiety
summary: Performance anxiety is worry about 'doing it right', lasting long enough or satisfying a partner. It can block arousal and erections — the worry itself becomes the problem.
key_points: Shifting focus from performance to sensation and connection helps.
Talking openly with a partner reduces pressure.
Persistent anxiety can be helped by a therapist.
